sensitive_columns: The three most sensitive columns in the warehouse are pan_number, bank_account_number, and personal_email because they contain highly sensitive personal and financial information requiring strict access controls.
hacker_target: The workforce/employee table (stg_workforce) would cause the most damage if leaked because it contains sensitive employee PII such as PAN numbers, personal emails, bank account details, and other personally identifiable information.
gdpr_risk: The stg_workforce table would need GDPR consent management first because it contains personal employee data such as emails, PAN-equivalent identifiers, and other information that can directly identify individuals.
